food_logs.healthier_alternative: Ask for less salt or soy sauce in the congee base. Request more lean chicken meat and skip any additional fried shallots or preserved vegetables often offered as sides, as these are high in sodium and fat. You can also opt for plain congee with just chicken and fresh garnishes.
Request steamed chicken breast without skin, swap half the oily rice for plain white/brown rice, and go easy on dark soy sauce and chili oil.
Do not drink the coconut milk broth completely — drinking only half the broth saves ~180 kcal and over 600mg of sodium! Omit fried tau pok.
